Ao se juntar a nós, você não apenas se torna parte de nossa história de sucesso, você ajuda a moldar o futuro e continua nosso rico legado que começou lá em 1874.


No Brasil somos a Atlas Schindler, estamos no país desde 1918, com mais de 100 anos de história. Fabricamos, instalamos, modernizamos e prestamos o melhor serviço de manutenção para elevadores, escadas e esteiras rolantes. Somos líderes do segmento de mobilidade urbana no Brasil, e procuramos para trabalhar com a gente pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores, que promovam um ótimo ambiente de trabalho para colegas e realizem um serviço excepcional aos clientes.


Técnico de Qualidade e Segurança do Produto I


Principais Responsabilidades:

Realizar ajustes e inspeções preventivas de qualidade e segurança nos Elevadores, através de visitas em campo e dentro do cronogramas estabelecidos, visando garantir a qualidade, segurança e desempenho dos novos equipamentos e instalações existentes conforme procedimentos definidos pelo grupo Schindler.


Quais os Requisitos?

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Formação técnica em mecânica;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens
  • Experiência com manutenção de elevadores, escadas e esteiras.


O que você ganha com isso?

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Previdência Privada e Cooperativa de Crédito;
  • Vale Refeição (com possibilidade de desmembramento parcial para Vale Alimentação) ou Restaurante no local – de acordo com a localidade de atuação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Plano de saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Assistência Farmácia
  • Seguro de Vida e de Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Eleve-se (Atendimento e apoio de profissionais especializados em Psicologia, Jurídico, Assistência Social, Nutrição, Educação Física, Fisioterapia, Educação Financeira, Pedagogia, e Assessoria PET);
  • Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida;
  • Cesta de Natal e Brinquedo para filhos de até 11 anos;
  • Plataforma de aprendizagem online de idiomas gratuita;
  • Parceria de descontos com universidades e outras instituições de ensino.
  • Wellhub.


Nós Elevamos... Sua carreira


Faça parte da nossa equipe e nos ajude a melhorar a qualidade de vida e a impulsionar a inovação, elevando o nível de segurança e sustentabilidade. Valorizamos suas diversas habilidades e perspectivas, pois juntos moldamos as cidades sustentáveis de hoje e de amanhã.


Você está pronto para embarcar em uma nova jornada? Junte-se ao #TeamSchindler! Descubra mais em nosso site de carreiras.

No Grupo Schindler, valorizamos a inclusão e a diversidade, e praticamos a equidade para criar oportunidades iguais para todos. Esforçamo-nos para que todos os candidatos qualificados recebam consideração para emprego independentemente de idade, raça, origem étnica, cor, filiação religiosa, filiação sindical, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, estado civil, origem nacional, nacionalidade, genética e saúde ou deficiência.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Operations Support | AI-First | Remote (LATAM)

Salary - USD $18,000 – $21,000/year  DOE + Monthly Health Insurance Bonus (~$100/mo)

Schedule - Monday–Friday, 8:30AM–5:30 PM EST

PTO - 10 days/year (accrual) | U.S. Holidays Off

Payments - Bi-weekly

Location - Remote — Latin America


This isn’t an assistant role where you wait to be told what to do.

This is a role where you own the details, drive the follow-through, and hold leadership accountable—even when it’s uncomfortable. If you need permission to take initiative, this isn’t the right fit. If you’re the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen, keep reading.


About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn’t optional here. It’s embedded in how we work.


We’re building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That’s what this role is.


About the Role

You’ll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a “take notes and schedule meetings” role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what’s falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren’t getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.


The Director will be the first to tell you: he’s a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn’t afraid to say “Hey, this still isn’t done and it needs to be.” If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.


You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.


What Makes You Different

We’ve titled this section intentionally. We’re not looking for a generic set of skills—we’re looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:


  • You’re a Self-Starter. You don’t wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don’t ask “Should I do this?”—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they’re communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you’re checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they’d send an invoice, you’re following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You’re not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he’d review something and hasn’t, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn’t confrontation—it’s how things actually get done.
  • You’re Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don’t let things slide because it’s easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You’re the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You’re Committed to Your Own Growth. You’re not just looking for a job—you’re looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.


A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can’t wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won’t be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who’s willing to engage. It’s a two-way street built on mutual respect.


Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director’s task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what’s overdue
  • Serve as the “closing engine” that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed


Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren’t aspirational posters on a wall. They’re how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:


  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems


Who Thrives in This Role


You thrive here if you’re the person who:

•  Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

•  Constantly asks: “How can this be automated or improved?”

•  Has been told “You’re more organized than my actual manager”

•  Isn’t intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

•  Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

•  Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball


What’s in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development


One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought “That’s me”—we want to hear from you. We’d rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.

title: Consultor SAP BRIM
description:
Consultor SAP BRIM – Convergent Charging

Início: imediato.

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado.

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto.

Horário de trabalho: 9h00 às 18h00.

Idioma: Inglês avançado.


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um Consultor SAP BRIM Sênior com forte experiência em SAP Convergent Charging (CC) para atuação em projetos e sustentação de soluções de billing e charging em ambientes de alta volumetria. O profissional será responsável pela modelagem, configuração e operação de cenários complexos de tarifação em tempo real e batch, integrando os componentes do SAP BRIM, como SOM, CI, FI-CA, e sistemas externos, como mediation, billing e CRM.


A posição envolve participação em implementações end-to-end, melhorias evolutivas e AMS, com forte atuação em desenho de solução, troubleshooting avançado, análise de performance e suporte à arquitetura BRIM.


Principais responsabilidades:


• Desenho e configuração de modelos de charging no SAP Convergent Charging.

• Criação e manutenção de Charge Plans, Charging Contexts, Price Plans e Charging Trees.

• Implementação de cenários de rating em tempo real (online charging) e batch (offline charging).

• Integração do SAP CC com SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI), SAP SOM e sistemas externos.

• Integração via Web Services, APIs e mediation systems.

• Troubleshooting de problemas de rating, inconsistências de consumo e performance de charging.

• Análise de logs e tuning de performance.

• Suporte a testes unitários, integrados e UAT.

• Participação na definição de arquitetura BRIM.

• Suporte em atividades de cutover e hypercare.

• Atuação tanto em projetos de implementação quanto em AMS/sustentação.


Requisitos Técnicos


• 6 a 8+ anos de experiência em SAP

• Pelo menos 3+ anos de experiência em SAP BRIM / Convergent Charging

• Experiência em pelo menos uma implementação end-to-end de BRIM.

• Conhecimento sólido de SAP BRIM (arquitetura end-to-end);

• Experiência avançada em SAP Convergent Charging (CC);

• Experiência com modelagem de pricing e rating.

• Experiência com integração entre SAP CC, SOM, CI, FI-CA e sistemas externos.

• Conhecimento de billing para telecom ou utilities.

• Experiência com Web Services, APIs e arquitetura distribuída.

• Experiência com análise de dados de alta volumetria e performance tuning.

• Forte experiência em troubleshooting e análise de logs.


Diferenciais


• Experiência com SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management);

• Conhecimento em SAP CI e FI-CA.

• Experiência com cenários pré-pagos e pós-pagos.

• Experiência em ambientes de grande escala (telecom ou utilities).


Competências Comportamentais


• Perfil analítico e orientado à solução.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

• Proatividade e autonomia;

• Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão;

• Organização e visão sistêmica


Perfil Profissional Esperado


Profissional sênior, com capacidade de atuar de forma independente em ambientes BRIM complexos, contribuindo com desenho de solução, sustentação de ambientes de alta volumetria e atuando como referência técnica em SAP Convergent Charging dentro do projeto ou operação.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Senior Back-end Architect (Python)

USD 46.2 - 59.8/hour.


Location:

Remote (specific timezones).


Mission of Staffinit:

We work with clients across industries, helping them build teams that make a difference, and support professionals in finding roles where they can thrive. At our core, we combine deep recruitment expertise with a human-centred approach—ensuring that each placement aligns skills, culture and ambition.

\"

  • You are proficient in REST API, Query optimization, Event-driven architecture (EDA), Data modeling.
  • You have +3 years experience in Python, Asynchronous programming.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python) at the Architect / Team Leader / Principal Engineer level to collaborate with our Customer.


Project:

- The project is being carried out for a German client and involves building an evaluation platform — a key system enabling the testing of AI agents through simulated scenarios and monitoring of performance results.


Role in the Project:

- The Senior Python Backend Engineer will collaborate with an internal development team and technical leads.

- The role includes full ownership of building and developing solutions and deploying them to production environments.

- Microservices must be high-performance, low-latency, scalable, and reliable.


Candidate Expectations:

- A combination of deep Python knowledge with system design skills, architectural thinking, independence, and proactivity.

- Strong sense of ownership.

- Strong communication skills.

- Independence in designing and evolving system architecture.

- These solutions directly impact the quality of experience for customers testing and deploying AI agents at scale.


Collaboration Model:

- Contract through end of 2026 with a high likelihood of extension.

- Remote work (100% FTE).

- Project team of 4–5 people based in Poland.

- Occasional visits to the Berlin office possible.


Team Office Meetings:

- The client organizes so-called in-office weeks — typically 3–5 days in the office, approximately twice per quarter.

- We try to schedule these flexibly around the team.

- Part of the team works from the UK and also joins these meetings.

- Attendance is not mandatory but is appreciated for collaboration and team building.


Requirements:

Python and Backend:

- Strong knowledge of modern Python, at least 3 years of experience with versions 3.10 and above (asyncio, concurrency, asynchronous programming).

- Experience building backend services running in production environments, 7+ years expected.


System Design and Maintenance:

- Designing and implementing REST APIs.

- Designing scalable distributed systems.

- Experience with event-driven architecture or task queue-based systems.

- Designing fault-tolerant and overload-resistant systems.

- Experience maintaining production systems.


Data Processing and Persistence:

- Production experience with databases (NoSQL, MongoDB preferred).

- Data modeling, schema management, migrations.

- Query and database structure optimization.


Concurrency and Task Processing:

- Background task processing architecture.

- Handling long-running and parallel tasks.

- Worker models and process isolation.


Engineering Ownership and Communication:

- End-to-end ownership of delivered solutions — from analyzing and verifying requirements, designing architecture, through to production deployment.

- Ability to make technical decisions, analyze and address risks.

- Good English communication skills.


Nice to Have:

Python Ecosystem:

- FastAPI or other async web frameworks.

- Pydantic and type-based validation.

- Static type checking (mypy).


Distributed and Event-Driven Systems:

- Kafka or similar streaming systems.

- Task queuing and load distribution systems.

- Multi-tenant system design.


Cloud and Containerization:

- Kubernetes and container deployments.

- CI/CD and deployment automation.


System Observability:

- Distributed tracing systems (e.g. OpenTelemetry).

- Metrics-based monitoring and SLOs.


Performance and Scaling:

- High-throughput systems.

- Load balancing and queue sharding.


AI / LLM Integrations:

- Integration with language model APIs.

- Designing evaluation and scoring pipelines.

- Managing rate limits and model query costs.


Work Environment and Tooling:

Backend and Infrastructure:

- FastAPI, Uvicorn,

- MongoDB (Motor).

- Redis (task queues).

- Kafka / Azure Event Hubs.

- Kong as middleware layer for LLM integrations.


Observability and Monitoring:

- OpenTelemetry.

- Datadog.

- Structured logging and trace correlation.


Delivery and Infrastructure:

- Kubernetes and Helm.

- Docker (multi-stage builds).

- GitHub Actions (CI/CD).

- ArgoCD (GitOps).


Python Tooling:

- UV (dependency management).

- Ruff, mypy.

- Pytest, testcontainers.


AI Integrations:

- OpenAI SDK and structured model responses.

- LLM Gateway architecture.

- Token usage and rate limit control.

title: Partner Analyst – Global Cloud & SAP Ecosystems
description:
Partner Analyst – Global Cloud & SAP Ecosystems

Contract - 12 Months

LATM Based - Remote Work


The Partner Analyst supports the development, governance, and optimisation of global partner programs across SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud . The role ensures partner program compliance, manages certifications and audits, maintains partner tier requirements, and oversees accurate pipeline reporting and deal registration across multiple partner portals. You’ll work cross‑functionally with sales, marketing, delivery, and finance to help maintain top‑tier partner status and maximise incentives, funding, and joint business opportunities.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.


Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .


Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.


Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.


Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.


Missão do cargo:

  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;

  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;


Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.

title: Market Data Database Support Engineer

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide.

We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database .

This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment , working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams.

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in production support / application support

  • Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation)
  • Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis
  • Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments
  • Knowledge of market data systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Experience with Refinitiv SLang
  • Familiarity with Process Monitor (ProcMon) or similar diagnostic tools
  • Exposure to Bloomberg or Refinitiv/LSEG data platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong investigative mindset – you enjoy digging into complex issues
  • Ability to trace problems across multiple layers (data source → ingestion → database → application)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with global stakeholders
  • Structured and analytical thinking
  • Proactive approach to identifying and solving issues

  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities

  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:

This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.

title: Data Scientist - Catálogo
description:

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução do catálogo como ativo central do negócio, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia, Design e Negócio.

  • Padronização de descrições e títulos
  • Inferência e sugestão de atributos
  • Classificação e reclassificação de produtos


  • Atuar na definição e otimização de:
  • Modelos e regras de categorização de produtos
  • Estratégias de enriquecimento e validação automática de atributos
  • Métricas de qualidade de catálogo (completude, consistência, acurácia e unicidade)


  • Trabalhar com modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo abordagens baseadas em NLP e LLMs, quando aplicável.

  • Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar o impacto das melhorias de enriquecimento e qualidade do catálogo.
  • Traduzir problemas de negócio e operacionais em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados escaláveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio na definição do roadmap técnico de catálogo.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados.
  • Forte domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital.
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: BigQuery, data lakes).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados.
  • Vivência com detecção de anomalias e métricas de qualidade de dados.
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado a dados de produtos (ex: normalização de descrições, extração de atributos).
  • Conhecimento em visualização de dados e storytelling analítico.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado:

  • Forte mentalidade de qualidade de dados como produto.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto de negócio.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.

title: System Architect
description:
Project Description:

Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration.


Responsibilities:

  • Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals.

  • Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment.

  • Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies.

  • Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance.
  • Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations.

  • • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems.
  • Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI.
  • Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact).
  • Strong embedded system architecture experience.
  • Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge.
  • Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration.
  • Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs.
  • Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures.
  • Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:

Compensation:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.  


As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established. 


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis , essa vaga é para você.


Sobre a Tipspace

A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.


Tecnologias do Projeto

Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:

  • Bancos de Dados relacionais
  • Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
  • SQL para consultas estruturadas
  • Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
  • Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código


Responsabilidades

Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
  • Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
  • Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
  • Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
  • Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção.


Requisitos

Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:

  • Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
  • Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
  • Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
  • Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso.


Benefícios e Condições

  • Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
  • Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
  • Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
  • Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
  • Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa.


Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!


Boa sorte e até breve

AdaptCFO is a fast-growing outsourced accounting and finance firm supporting small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S.


We are hiring a Client Experience Specialist to own the day-to-day execution of client delivery, billing accuracy, and operational coordination across the business.


This role sits at the center of our organization, working directly with clients, our accounting team, and leadership to ensure:


  • Deliverables are completed on time and within budget
  • Billing is accurate and aligned with work performed
  • Clients are supported and retained
  • Operational processes run efficiently as we scale


Success in this role means creating a consistent, reliable client experience while reducing internal bottlenecks and identifying opportunities for growth.


This is a high-impact, hands-on role with a clear path into leadership as the company grows.




Key Responsibilities



Client Experience & Communication


  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Manage client communication, follow-ups, and requests
  • Support and help lead client check-ins and QBRs
  • Proactively identify and resolve client issues




Delivery & Budget Accountability


  • Track monthly deliverables across bookkeeping, controller, and CFO services
  • Ensure deadlines are met (10–15 business day close target)
  • Monitor team utilization and ensure work stays within budget
  • Flag risks early and drive resolution




Billing & Revenue Accuracy


  • Assist with client billing and invoice preparation
  • Ensure billing aligns with scope, deliverables, and hours worked
  • Identify underbilling, missed charges, and scope creep
  • Help maintain consistent and scalable billing processes




Upsells & Account Growth


  • Identify opportunities for additional services (CFO, cleanup, add-ons)
  • Surface opportunities to leadership and support execution
  • Ensure clients are properly scoped as they grow




Onboarding


  • Support onboarding of new clients
  • Coordinate data collection, access, and system setup
  • Ensure a smooth transition into recurring workflows




Team Coordination


  • Work closely with offshore accounting team (Philippines) and U.S.-based CFOs
  • Maintain clear communication and accountability across teams
  • Identify performance gaps and escalate when needed




Operations & Process Improvement


  • Help build and refine SOPs across onboarding, delivery, and billing
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements
  • Support operational structure as the company scales




What Success Looks Like


  • Clients are satisfied, retained, and not escalating issues
  • Monthly closes are consistently on time
  • Work is delivered within budgeted hours
  • Billing is accurate, complete, and timely
  • Upsell opportunities are identified and acted on
  • Leadership is not pulled into day-to-day execution




Qualifications


  • 2–5+ years of experience in operations, client services, or service-based businesses
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable managing multiple clients and priorities
  • Ability to hold team members accountable in a professional way
  • Experience in accounting, finance, or professional services is a strong plus
  • Experience with tools like QuickBooks, HubSpot, or similar platforms is a plus




Compensation


  • Base Salary: $24,000 – $42,000 USD (depending on experience)



Performance Bonus


  • Annual bonus tied to client retention
  • Additional upside tied to upsell support and revenue growth




Why AdaptCFO


  • Fully remote team
  • High ownership role with direct impact on the business
  • Clear path to leadership as the company grows
  • Exposure to U.S.-based clients and finance operations
  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

title: Technical Support Analyst (SAP ATLAS)
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail‑oriented IT Technical Support Engineer to join our ATLAS (Automation of Customer Life Cycle across SAP) team.

In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting the end‑to‑end lifecycle of SAP solution landscapes for enterprise customers — from onboarding through offboarding. You’ll work across teams to ensure landscapes are accurately configured, monitored, and transitioned through key lifecycle stages while delivering high‑quality, reliable support.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem‑solving, collaboration, and ownership , and who thrives in a fast‑paced, customer‑focused environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage and drive resolution of customer issues in collaboration with internal and external support teams
  • Investigate and resolve tickets raised via Jira (and soon ServiceNow )
  • Validate customer landscape configurations, lifecycle statuses, and key milestones using internal tools
  • Identify root causes of discrepancies (e.g., incorrect system statuses, missing dates) and implement corrective actions
  • Coordinate with internal and customer‑facing units (CFUs) to ensure clear ownership and timely resolution
  • Ensure operational data (fulfilment dates, landscape statuses, etc.) is accurate and compliant with internal policies
  • Support reliability and availability efforts aligned with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles
  • Document solutions and contribute to knowledge bases, process wikis, and operational documentation
  • Mentor new team members during onboarding, feature rollouts, or process changes
  • Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and service quality
  • Create and analyze reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to track trends and performance metrics


Qualifications and Requirements:


  • Experience in IT Technical Support, customer operations, or enterprise system support
  • Advanced English
  • Exposure to ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
  • Hands‑on experience supporting at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Experience working in or alongside Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills for troubleshooting complex issues
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow
  • Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment
  • A strong sense of ownership with a proactive approach to problem‑solving and process improvement
  • Willingness to learn complex systems and contribute to continuous operational improvement


Nice to Have


  • Understanding of SLA/KPI‑driven operations
  • Familiar with SAP ATLAS
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B software solutions , ideally SAP‑related.


Please submite resumé in English

title: SDR - , , Brazil
description:

Você será o primeiro SDR da empresa , trabalhando em parceria direta com nosso Inside Sales Specialist para implementar a máquina de vendas previsível. Esta é uma oportunidade única de construir processos do zero , ser a porta de entrada de todos os leads digitais e participar ativamente de uma estratégia que visa 10x o volume de oportunidades qualificadas .


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Qualificar leads gerados pelo marketing digital e prospecção ativa, identificando oportunidades reais (SQL - Sales Qualified Leads) e passando-as para o Inside Sales, seguindo rigorosamente a metodologia \"Receita Previsível\" .


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

QUALIFICAÇÃO DE LEADS INBOUND (50%)

  • Contatar 100% dos leads em até 30 minutos após captura.
  • Realizar qualificação inicial usando metodologia BANT (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline).
  • Identificar dor, urgência e fit com nosso portfólio.
  • Nutrir leads que não estão prontos para compra (lead nurturing).

PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA OUTBOUND (30%)

  • Executar cadências de prospecção em leads definidos pelo marketing
  • Realizar cold calls e cold emails estruturados
  • Pesquisar empresas e tomadores de decisão no LinkedIn/Google
  • Gerar SQLs através de prospecção ativa
  • Mapear empresas do setor de construção civil, indústria e manutenção

GESTÃO DE PIPELINE E PROCESSOS (15%)

  • Manter CRM 100% atualizado e organizado.
  • Documentar todas as interações com leads.
  • Seguir e otimizar playbooks de qualificação
  • Registrar objeções e padrões identificados
  • Participar de reuniões de forecast e planejamento

ALINHAMENTO COM MARKETING E INSIDE SALES (5%)

  • Fornecer feedback diário sobre qualidade dos leads por canal
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento (marketing + vendas)
  • Colaborar no aprimoramento de ICPs (Ideal Customer Profile) e personas
  • Sugerir melhorias nas campanhas baseadas no contato com prospects


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência : Em vendas B2B, telemarketing qualificado ou atendimento comercial
  • Comunicação : Excelente dicção, persuasão e escrita profissional
  • Resiliência : Capacidade de lidar com \"não\" e fazer follow-ups consistentes
  • Organização : Disciplina para seguir processos e atualizar CRM diariamente
  • Perfil Hunter : Proatividade para prospecção ativa e busca de novas oportunidades

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Conhecimento do livro \"Receita Previsível\" ou \"Fanatical Prospecting\" (Jeb Blount)
  • Experiência com cold calling estruturado
  • Vivência no setor industrial, construção civil ou distribuição B2B
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Social Selling (LinkedIn Sales Navigator)
  • Conhecimento em metodologias BANT, GPCT ou MEDDIC

COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Persistência : Não desiste após o primeiro \"não\", segue cadências completas
  • Curiosidade : Faz perguntas para entender a fundo a dor do prospect
  • Coachability : Aceita feedback e implementa rapidamente melhorias
  • Orientação por métricas : Acompanha seus números e busca superá-los
  • Trabalho em equipe : Colabora efetivamente com Inside Sales e Marketing


METAS E INDICADORES:

PROGRESSÃO DE VOLUME

  • Mês 1-2 : 70-100 leads/dia (período de treinamento e ajuste)
  • Mês 3-4 : 100 - 150 leads/dia
  • Mês 5+ : 150 - 200+ leads/dia

ATIVIDADES DIÁRIAS ESPERADAS

  • 100 - 200 tentativas de contato (calls, emails, WhatsApp)
  • 30 - 40 conversas efetivas com decisores
  • 8-12 SQLs gerados por dia (pós-rampa)


REMUNERAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS:

ESTRUTURA SALARIAL

  • Salário Base : R$ 2.800,00
  • Comissão por SQL Aceito : Valor específico por SQL aprovado pelo Inside Sales (Critérios definidos após contratação).
  • Bônus Trimestral : R$ 1.000,00 (atingimento de 100% da meta do setor comercial)

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Vale refeição : R$ 26,00 por dia útil

PLANO DE CARREIRA:

  • 6 meses : SDR Pleno (transição baseada em performance) .
  • 12 meses : SDR Sênior (liderança de novos SDRs) (transição baseada em performance) .
  • 18-24 meses : Promoção para Inside Sales Specialist (transição baseada em performance) .


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS:

  • Modalidade: Presencial;
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta, 8h às 17:48h;

title: Full Stack Developer (Python) - Founding Engineer
description:
About Sofira:

Sofira is building the future of legal services. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work, leveraging our team's 12 years of experience processing millions of legal documents.


The Opportunity: Become a Founding Engineer

This isn't just another Senior Developer role. This is a chance to be a core member of our founding engineering team, reporting directly to our CTO, Pedro Leme (ex-Head of Engineering at Jusbrasil).

You will be solving some of the most complex and interesting technical challenges in the Brazilian tech scene today. Your mission will be to build a robust, scalable platform that tames the chaos of legacy government systems and leverages the latest in Generative AI to deliver real-world value. If you are driven by solving hard problems that have a massive impact and want to build the technical foundations of a future market leader, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do (Your Mission):

  • Design and build the foundational architecture for our AI agent platform, ensuring it is scalable, resilient, and secure from day one to support our journey towards ISO 27001 certification.
  • Lead the complex engineering challenge of integrating with dozens of legacy government systems, transforming our core competitive advantage into a robust and reliable service.
  • Develop the data and machine learning infrastructure that powers our agents—including our proprietary data processing pipelines and vector databases—in close collaboration with our ML Engineer.
  • Take full ownership of key features across the entire stack, from our Python backend and APIs to our modern frontend, ensuring a seamless and high-quality user experience.
  • Champion engineering excellence through high-quality code, robust testing, and collaborative code reviews, helping to define the technical culture of Sofira as a founding engineer.


Who You Are (The Profile):

We value your mindset and your ability to execute above all else. You are the right fit if:

  • You have a deep sense of ownership.  You don't just write code; you take ownership of features from the initial idea through to deployment and maintenance. You feel the pain when things break and the pride when customers are delighted.
  • You are a pragmatic builder with a natural 'hacker mindset'.  You don't freeze when faced with the unknown; you find the simplest, most efficient path through complex problems. You have a strong bias for action and favor clever, practical solutions that work now over theoretically perfect ones that might work someday.
  • You are relentlessly proactive and a self-starter.  You don't wait for tasks. You see opportunities for improvement in the codebase, in the infrastructure, or in a process, and you take the initiative to fix them.
  • You are a true Full Stack professional.  You are comfortable and skilled in both backend and frontend development and are not afraid to learn new technologies to get the job done.
  • You are a strong collaborator.  You enjoy working in a tight-knit team, engaging in healthy debates about technical decisions, and mentoring other engineers as the team grows. You know how to leverage your peers to find the best solutions.
  • You are mission-driven and ambitious.  You are excited by the opportunity to build a category-defining company from the ground up. You are energized by the mission, not just the clock.


What You'll Need (The Hard Skills):

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Deep expertise in Python  and at least one of its web frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask).
  • Solid experience with a modern frontend framework (e.g., React, Vue, Svelte).
  • Strong knowledge of SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications on a major cloud provider (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Fluency in English.
  • Huge Plus (Bonus Points):
  • Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.).
  • Familiarity with the RAG pattern, LangChain, or vector databases.
  • Familiarity with AI Agents patterns and libs.
  • Previous experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS startup.


Why You'll Love Building Sofira With Us:

  • Solve Hard, Interesting Problems:  You will work on a unique technical challenge – taming Brazil's legacy systems with modern AI. This is not another CRUD app.
  • Build with the Best Tools:  We have an AI-first engineering culture. You will be equipped with tools like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to maximize your productivity and focus on creative problem-solving.
  • Build from Zero & Have a Massive Impact:  As a founding engineer, your decisions will shape our product, our culture, and our future success.
  • Ownership:  We want our founding team to have a real stake in our success.

title: Clinical Application Specialist
description:
A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with FibroScan® , the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health.

FibroScan® is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines.

Echosens has made FibroScan® available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.

Echosens is shaping the future of liver health . As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.

In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH ), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.


Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.


To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:


CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)

LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)


The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.


This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.



Main activities:


  • Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens FibroScan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
  • Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
  • Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
  • Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise


Experience / Education / Special Requirements



You have a bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.


You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.


Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.


You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.



Please submit your application and CV in English.



Why join ECHOSENS ?


  • Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world.
  • Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference.
  • Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development.
  • Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation.
  • Adhere to our inclusion, equality and diversity program set up to support our employees in their efforts to be recognized as workers with disabilities.




ECHOSENS is an equal opportunity company in an environment of diversity and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, health or disability, or any other status protected by law.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior HR & Office Administration Analyst
description:
We are supporting a global company in the search for a highly qualified Senior HR & Office Administration Analyst in São Paulo, Brazil.


POSITION SUMMARY


The Senior HR & Office Administration Analyst will support the Country Director in leading the Human Resources and Administrative routines of the business, ensuring operational excellence, compliance and efficient employee experience. This position plays a key role in maintaining HR processes, payroll interface, office administration, vendor management and employee engagement initiatives, contributing directly to the smooth running of the organization. Advanced to fluent English is mandatory, as this role requires daily interaction with the international headquarters and corporate stakeholders.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


HUMAN RESOURCES:


  • Maintain and update employee records, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with internal policies and legal requirements.
  • Prepare and submit employee data to Group HR for demographic analysis and management reporting.
  • Support employee insurance administration, including enrollments, submissions, and claims follow-up, ensuring timely and accurate processing.
  • Oversee the payroll process managed by the outsourced payroll provider, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with statutory obligations.
  • Review payroll reports and validate all relevant information prior to processing and payment deadlines.
  • Act as the focal point between local operations, Group HR, and the payroll provider to ensure that employee movements such as new hires, terminations, salary changes, and other updates are accurately reflected in payroll.
  • Support HR routines related to employee relations, performance management, training coordination, and general people operations.


ADMINISTRATION:


  • Oversee office facilities, supplies, and equipment maintenance to ensure business continuity and a well-functioning workplace.
  • Manage vendor contracts, service providers, and service agreements, ensuring quality, compliance, and cost control.
  • Ensure the timely renewal of business licenses, permits, subscriptions, and other required documentation.
  • Coordinate employee engagement initiatives, internal meetings, and company events.
  • Provide administrative support to the leadership team, including scheduling, correspondence, travel arrangements, hotel bookings, transportation, and other logistics.
  • Organize accommodation, transportation, courier services, and office support services required for daily business operations.
  • Maintain organized office files, records, and administrative documentation, ensuring accessibility and accuracy.


REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration or related fields is preferred.

Solid knowledge of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and HR best practices.

Microsoft Office and HRIS
