title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
The Company

Push is an all-in-one platform that helps businesses grow and scale their companies by simplifying HR, payroll, time tracking, and scheduling. Our purpose is to help our customers free up their time by making people management ridiculously easy, so they can focus on their passion.


Our customer base includes some of the biggest brands, such as Earls Restaurant, Cactus Club, Crumbl Cookies and more.


The Team

We’re a collaborative, dog-loving, people-first crew that values curiosity, initiative, and kindness. Our culture is built on the belief that when people are supported to grow, great things happen for them and for our customers. As part of our growing team, you'll play a key role in helping our customers realize the full value of Push from day one.


Take a look at a day in the life of our team: Behind the Scenes with our Software Engineers


The Role

We're looking for an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our growing Engineering team! If you have a sharp eye for detail and a passion for ensuring quality through hands-on manual and automated testing, this role could be a perfect fit. You will play a key role in embedding quality into every stage of the development lifecycle.


You’ll influence automation initiatives, refine QA processes, and mentor others on best practices. Your primary responsibility will be identifying bugs, verifying fixes, and ensuring a high-quality product experience for our customers.


This role collaborates closely with our Vancouver team. The successful candidate will work 10:00am - 6:00pm local Brazil time to ensure sufficient time zone overlap.


Job Duties:

  • Champion quality assurance and lead the adoption of best practices across the product and engineering teams
  • Collaborate closely with developers, designers, and product managers to define effective test strategies and acceptance criteria
  • Plan, design, and execute detailed manual and automated test cases to ensure full coverage of features and user scenarios
  • Drive technical decisions for our software testing processes and tools
  • Build, maintain, and help drive the direction of the test automation framework
  • Mentor test engineers on automation best practices
  • Identify, document, and track defects with clear and actionable reporting
  • Verify fixes, maintain comprehensive regression test suites, and drive continuous improvement of QA processes
  • Conduct exploratory, usability, and edge-case testing to uncover hidden issues
  • Produce detailed test reports and effectively communicate findings and risks to stakeholders
  • Help define, maintain, and improve test environments to mirror production conditions
  • Continuously evaluate and enhance QA workflows, tooling (including modern AI tools), and team efficiency


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing or QA, with proven expertise in manual and automated testing and strong analytical skills
  • Experience designing and implementing QA strategies in agile development environments
  • Hands-on experience with test automation tools such as Cypress , Selenium , or similar frameworks
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field
  • Demonstrated success in elevating QA standards and improving product quality across releases
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, tools, and testing lifecycles
  • Proficiency in exploratory, regression, and smoke testing techniques
  • Experience with cross-browser, cross-platform, and responsive UI testing
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Familiarity with Jira or other project management and defect tracking tools
  • Familiarity with source control management tools such as Git
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating tests into automated build processes
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or another high-level programming language
  • Leadership experience in software development or software testing
  • Proficiency with modern AI-driven tools such as Claude Code


Bonus Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience with performance, security, or accessibility testing
  • Experience in startup or fast-paced environments
  • Knowledge of AWS or other cloud platforms
  • Experience testing mobile applications
  • Experience leading a team of software testers


Why Push?

  • Do what you love. We believe in work that energizes you and supports your passions.
  • Grow yourself. At Push, personal and professional development go hand in hand.
  • Make an impact. Your knowledge and guidance will shape the success stories of businesses across North America.


Check out our About Us video


Additional Information

We value non-traditional career paths. If your experience doesn’t check every box but you’re excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply.


Push is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity makes us stronger and more innovative.


--

To help our hiring team with the review process, please ensure your resume is submitted in English.

description:
About the job

Company Description

Rose Talent Solutions partners with growing businesses to build full-time offshore teams that function seamlessly as part of their in-house staff. All of our team members work U.S. business hours and integrate directly into existing systems to deliver optimal results.

To Apply, fill out this application form here:

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a LinkedIn Strategy & Content Manager. This role also covers email automation and campaign tracking, so you need to be comfortable across LinkedIn, GoHighLevel, and Google Analytics.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work
  • Extremely detail-oriented with a test-before-you-launch mindset
  • Clear communication and ability to capture someone else's voice authentically

What the role is not

  • Not just scheduling posts — you're developing the content strategy and writing in the CEO's voice

  • Not focused on vanity metrics — we care about qualified leads and real pipeline impact

A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

title: SAP GRC Senior Lead
description:
SAP GRC Senior Lead - Sao Paulo-Guararema


Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.


Role Overview

Step into a high-impact leadership role as SAP GRC Senior Lead within Mars Global Services, our shared services division, and help shape the future of Mars Inc. through our Digital Core transformation. The Digital Core is Mars’ strategic initiative to modernize and unify our SAP landscape, leveraging S/4HANA on RISE to drive operational excellence, security, and compliance across our global business.


In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, deployment, and ongoing operation of the SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system—an essential component of our Digital Core. The GRC Access Control (AC) system enables compliant user access processes, including access request provisioning, segregation of duties, and emergency access management (Firefighter), ensuring that only the right people have the right access at the right time.


Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with the Digital Core Security Team and Controls Team to ensure the GRC AC system is robust, scalable, and ready to support ongoing go-lives and deployments of user populations onto the Digital Core S/4HANA platform. You will also provide oversight and guidance for the steady-state operations of the GRC AC solution, helping Mars maintain the highest standards of security and compliance as we continue our transformation journey.


What are we looking for?

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring SAP GRC Access Control, including MSMP workflow, BRF+ configuration, connector setup, rule set creation, and master data management
  • Proven experience implementing SAP security and GRC in S/4HANA transformation programs, with a strong understanding of GRC’s role in project lifecycles
  • Deep knowledge of SAP security role-based access controls, IT General Computer Controls, segregation of duties, sensitive access risks, and mitigating controls
  • Expertise in SAP identity management concepts such as user provisioning, access reviews, terminations, and single sign-on
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP Basis, Identity, and Architecture teams to design integrated security solutions involving GRC
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) implementation is a plus
  • Strong communication skills to present complex GRC and security topics to both technical and business audiences


What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Own the end-to-end SAP GRC solution for the new S/4HANA on RISE Digital Core landscape
  • Design and enhance SAP GRC solution architecture to meet evolving business needs
  • Integrate SAP GRC with other systems and data sources to ensure seamless compliance management
  • Configure GRC Access Control workflows, rule sets, and security roles with precision
  • Manage GRC master data setup and conduct thorough testing aligned with S/4HANA transformation phases
  • Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, and troubleshoot complex GRC issues
  • Create and maintain comprehensive GRC configuration and training documentation
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions to Mars SAP Security AMS support teams to ensure smooth steady-state operations
  • Support SAP Security Project Team in planning and incorporating GRC tasks into S/4 implementation timelines and status reporting


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus

If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. Essa pessoa fará parte do time de engenharia e será responsável por desenvolver soluções de IA aplicadas ao produto, integrando modelos de linguagem com dados reais, sistemas internos e fluxos de negócio.


Nosso objetivo é construir uma plataforma orientada a inteligência artificial, com uso de RAG, agentes e múltiplas bases de conhecimento (relacionais, vetoriais e grafos), aplicadas a contextos educacionais e corporativos.


Não buscamos um perfil acadêmico ou focado em treinamento de modelos. Buscamos alguém que saiba transformar IA em produto real.


O que você vai fazer:


  • Desenvolver funcionalidades baseadas em LLMs integradas à plataforma
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Estruturar e evoluir bases de conhecimento (dados estruturados, vetoriais e grafos)
  • Construir e orquestrar agentes e fluxos de execução (tools, multi-agents, etc.)
  • Integrar IA com sistemas existentes (APIs, banco de dados, serviços internos)
  • Trabalhar na qualidade das respostas (avaliação, melhoria contínua, contexto)
  • Otimizar custo, latência e performance das aplicações de IA
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia na evolução da arquitetura da plataforma


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com uso de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • Experiência com construção de RAG e uso de embeddings
  • Experiência com integração de IA em aplicações reais (não apenas protótipos)
  • Conhecimento em APIs, backend e integração entre sistemas
  • Capacidade de estruturar e trabalhar com diferentes tipos de dados
  • Experiência com debugging e evolução de sistemas em produção
  • Mentalidade de engenharia (performance, custo, confiabilidade)


Stack e Tecnologias (IA e Dados):


  • LLMs e APIs de IA (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Bases vetoriais (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares)
  • Bases de grafos e conhecimento (Neo4j ou similares)
  • Orquestração de agentes (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno ou abordagens próprias)
  • Integração com APIs e serviços internos
  • Backend para orquestração (Node.js, Python ou PHP)


Perfil esperado:


  • Consegue transformar IA em funcionalidades reais de produto
  • Pensa em dados, contexto e qualidade de resposta
  • Não depende de frameworks específicos para resolver problemas
  • Consegue trabalhar com autonomia e explorar soluções
  • Equilibra experimentação com responsabilidade técnica

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Você deve ser um entusiasta da eficiência, utilizando ferramentas de IA e agentes para acelerar o ciclo de desenvolvimento, permitindo que seu foco esteja na resolução de problemas complexos de arquitetura e estratégia de dados.

  • Impacto Cross-Team: Atuar além do próprio time, identificando dependências, mitigando riscos técnicos e garantindo que as integrações com os times de Dados sejam fluidas e performáticas.
  • Excelência Operacional: Definir e zelar por padrões de confiabilidade (SLOs) e observabilidade, transformando aprendizados de incidentes em melhorias sistêmicas para reduzir o toil.

Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em engenharia de computação ou ciência da computação ou possuir experiência prática nessas áreas

Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência com pipeline de processamento de dados
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Go e Python

title: Sr Performance Management Specialist
description:
Join a market-leading financial services firm at a moment of transformation in how we measure, grow, and recognize performance. This role sits at the intersection of performance management, people analytics, and talent systems, partnering with senior HR and business leaders to elevate performance practices—making them more consistent, data-driven, and genuinely developmental.


You’ll be the person who can translate complex data into clear insights, run high-stakes talent forums, and design performance rhythms that leaders trust. If you enjoy combining analytics + executive storytelling + operational rigor, this is for you.


What you’ll do

  • Own and evolve the performance management cycle end-to-end (goal setting, mid-year, year-end, promotions linkage where applicable).
  • Lead and facilitate performance conversations with leaders: coaching, challenging, and ensuring fairness and clarity.
  • Drive 9-box talent reviews, calibration sessions, and governance forums—ensuring decisions are evidence-based and aligned to policy and culture.
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards and analytics (trends, distribution shifts, rater bias signals, differentiation, attrition risk correlations, time-to-readiness, etc.).
  • Create crisp, executive-ready materials: PowerPoint narratives and Excel models that senior stakeholders can act on immediately.
  • Partner closely with HRBPs, Total Rewards, Talent Management, and business leadership to align performance outcomes with development actions.
  • Support (and often lead) enhancements to talent management systems and performance workflows; identify opportunities for automation and stronger data integrity.


What we’re looking for (must-haves)

  • 3+ years of experience in performance management, people/talent analytics, or closely related HR COE work (ideally in complex, fast-paced environments).
  • Demonstrated hands-on leadership of:
  • Performance conversations (manager enablement, coaching, communication)
  • 9-box facilitation and outcomes
  • Calibration design and execution
  • Expert-level PowerPoint and Excel skills: you can build a leadership narrative, not just slides; you can model and audit data confidently (pivots, advanced formulas, scenario views; PowerQuery is a plus).
  • Strong experience with talent management / performance management software (enterprise tools).
  • Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken). Spanish is a plus.


Nice to have


  • Experience with performance management tools (Oracle, Success Factors, other)
  • Familiarity with change management and rollouts across large populations.


How success looks in this role


  • Leaders describe the process as clear, fair, and decision-ready—not a compliance exercise.
  • Calibration outcomes show reduced noise, improved differentiation quality, and stronger documentation.
  • Performance insights shift from “reporting what happened” to predicting and influencing outcomes.
  • Executive stakeholders rely on your materials because they are simple, sharp, and data-grounded

title: AI Program Manager
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled AI Program Manager to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil, Bulgaria, or Romania. Candidates who are able to work hybrid from our Sofia, Bulgaria or São Carlos, Brazil offices will be given preference.

Industry: IT & Services


AI Program Manager | About You

As an AI Program Manager, you are responsible for coordinating and driving execution across AI‑focused software delivery teams. You bring strong experience supporting programs that involve machine learning workflows, data governance, model development, and cloud‑based AI product delivery. You thrive in Agile environments and excel at bringing structure, alignment, and predictability to complex cross‑team initiatives. You communicate clearly with engineering, product, and data science partners, ensuring dependencies, risks, and priorities are well understood. You are detail‑oriented, highly organized, and skilled at maintaining governance standards while enabling teams to deliver AI capabilities efficiently and consistently.


AI Program Manager | Day-to-Day

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies for AI and ML engineering PODs, ensuring all teams follow established AI delivery frameworks and governance processes.
  • Coordinate planning activities with Product, ML Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Architecture by documenting requirements, dependencies, milestones, and risks.
  • Maintain governance artifacts including schedules, RAID logs, decision records, and AI‑specific delivery documentation.
  • Track progress across AI workstreams, capturing updates from sprint reviews, model checkpoints, training cycles, and evaluation sessions.
  • Support cross‑functional alignment by coordinating client engagement logistics, AI use‑case prioritization, and model delivery readiness.
  • Prepare bi‑weekly delivery reports summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and upcoming AI release milestones using Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.


AI Program Manager | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience supporting software, SaaS, or AI/ML delivery programs in an Agile environment.
  • Proven experience coordinating AI‑enabled product development, including data pipelines, model training workflows, feature engineering, or ML deployment cycles.
  • Strong ability to manage inter‑team dependencies and align work across Product, ML Engineering, Data Science, and Cloud Engineering teams.
  • Experience maintaining program schedules, RAID logs, delivery documentation, and governance artifacts across multiple PODs or workstreams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, and Confluence, including structured reporting and dashboard creation.
  • Familiarity with AI delivery concepts including data governance, model lifecycle stages, technical risks, and responsible AI considerations.

A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).


Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

description:

Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos projetos dos clientes Timeware — do planejamento à entrega — garantindo controle de atividades, evolução por frentes, comunicação executiva (status report/newsletter) e relacionamento contínuo no pós-venda (perfil farmer ), atuando como ponte entre stakeholders e times técnicos.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Conduzir a rotina de delivery : planejar sprints, acompanhar execução, remover impedimentos e gerir dependências.
  • Manter o Jira vivo : boards, epics, stories, burndown, dashboards e relatórios padronizados por cliente.
  • Status Report executivo quinzenal/mensal: progresso por frente, riscos, plano de ação, próximos passos e decisões pendentes.
  • Newsletter de projetos para stakeholders: highlights, marcos, releases e métricas de saúde.
  • Gerenciamento de roadmap e releases (em parceria com Produto/Tech Leads).
  • Reuniões e visitas a clientes (pós-venda farmer): alinhamento, satisfação, identificação de upsell/cross-sell e oportunidades.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (planning, daily, review, retro, refinement) e adotar boas práticas de fluxo (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Acompanhar OKRs / KPIs de delivery (lead time, throughput, previsibilidade, SLA, NPS).
  • Produzir apresentações executivas (PowerPoint) e planos de projeto (escopo, cronograma, riscos, comunicação).
  • Garantir rastreabilidade : decisões, atas, RAID log e versionamento dos artefatos.
  • Trabalhar com áreas técnicas (Engenharia, QA, SRE, Dados) para definir abordagens, estimativas e critérios de aceite.


Atividades do dia a dia:


  • Atualizar boards, prioridades e dependências no Jira.
  • Preparar dashboards e relatórios (Jira/Excel/PowerPoint).
  • Rodar dailies/semanais com o time e checkpoint executivo com o cliente.
  • Monitorar riscos e acionar plano de mitigação .
  • Consolidar release notes e comunicar entregas.
  • Visitar clientes (agenda combinada) para health-check e alinhamento de expectativas.


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills):


  • Métodos : Scrum, Kanban, Lean, Lean Inception , Design Thinking, PMBOK/PMI, ITIL (gestão de mudanças e incidentes).
  • Ferramentas : Jira (obrigatório), Confluence, Microsoft Project, PowerPoint (avançado), Excel (tabelas dinâmicas / gráficos),
  • Visio/Miro/Draw.io; noções de Power BI são bem-vindas.
  • Gestão por métricas : lead/cycle time, CFD, burndown/burnup, throughput, previsibilidade, capacidade.
  • Documentação : RAID log, matriz RACI, cronogramas, atas e planos de comunicação.
  • Inglês : leitura técnica; conversa é diferencial.


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):


  • Organização e senso de dono (accountability).
  • Comunicação executiva (escrita e fala objetivas, visuais claros).
  • Negociação e alinhamento de expectativas com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Priorizar sob pressão mantendo qualidade e previsibilidade.
  • Visão cliente (farmer) : relacionamento, percepção de valor e expansão.


Diferenciais:


  • Certificações: PSM/CSM, KMP, PMI-ACP, ITIL , OKRs/Lean Inception.
  • Vivência com produtos digitais, SaaS, SRE/DevOps, dados/BI .
  • Experiência montando comitês executivos e governança de portfolios .
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados (compliance, auditoria, segurança).

title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Web and Mobile Features
description:
The Company

Push is an all-in-one platform that helps businesses grow and scale their companies by simplifying HR, payroll, time tracking, and scheduling. Our purpose is to help our customers free up their time by making people management ridiculously easy, so they can focus on their passion.


Our customer base includes some of the biggest brands, such as Earls Restaurant, Cactus Club, Crumbl Cookies and more.


The Team

We’re a collaborative, dog-loving, people-first crew that values curiosity, initiative, and kindness. Our culture is built on the belief that when people are supported to grow, great things happen for them and for our customers. As part of our growing team, you'll play a key role in helping our customers realize the full value of Push from day one.


Take a look at a day in the life of our team: Behind the Scenes with our Software Engineers


The Role

We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer who is comfortable building across the stack—front end, back end, and mobile. You’ll be developing core features that power Push Operations’ workforce management platform, collaborating closely with product, design, and AI teams to deliver intuitive user experiences and scalable backend systems. Proficiency in React and/or Native (or related cross-platform frameworks) is an important part of this role, as our mobile apps are central to how customers interact with Push.


This role collaborates closely with our Vancouver team. The successful candidate will work 10:00am - 6:00pm local Brazil time to ensure sufficient time zone overlap.


Job Duties:

  • Design, build, and maintain features across the full stack built using a variety of languages and technologies
  • Front-end: React/React Native web and mobile applications
  • Back-end: PHP (and related frameworks), Node.js, RESTful APIs, microservices
  • Data: database schemas, integrations, and optimization
  • Collaborate with designers and product managers to turn requirements into elegant, user-friendly solutions
  • Ensure high performance, security, and scalability across systems
  • Build mobile experiences with React Native or related technology, ensuring smooth integration with backend services
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code; participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize performance issues across web, mobile, and back-end layers
  • Stay current with evolving tools, frameworks, and best practices for full stack and mobile development


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer
  • Proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks (React, React Native, Node.js )
  • Proficiency with PHP or a related backend framework (Laravel, Symfony, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, and database systems (SQL/NoSQL)
  • Experience integrating frontends and mobile apps with back-end APIs
  • Familiarity with mobile-specific challenges (app store deployments, push notifications)
  • Solid grasp of testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is an asset
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills
  • A passion for solving real-world problems with technology that makes a difference in people's lives
  • Proficiency with modern AI-driven tools such as Claude Code


Bonus Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience with mobile analytics (Firebase, LogRocket, Mixpanel)
  • Familiarity with workforce management, HR compliance, or payroll systems
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards for both web and mobile


Why Push?

  • Do what you love. We believe in work that energizes you and supports your passions.
  • Grow yourself. At Push, personal and professional development go hand in hand.
  • Make an impact. Your knowledge and guidance will shape the success stories of businesses across North America.


Check out our About Us video

title: Payroll Analyst
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

This team is responsible for the ongoing coordination of payroll processing activities, including the collection and validation of payroll inputs, and the validation and controls of monthly payroll run outputs, with the overarching objective of processing salaries in a timely and accurate manner across the region. The team liaises continuously with multiple internal stakeholders (employees, HR and Finance colleagues) and the outsourced payroll services provider, providing expert advice on payroll-related topics.


Job Description

The Payroll Analyst is responsible for the complete, end-to-end management and execution of the payroll cycle for the Brazilian entity, ensuring flawless accuracy, strict legal compliance, and maximum process efficiency.

This professional will serve as the primary payroll and Personnel Administration (DP) subject matter expert (SME), closely collaborating with the Finance, Human Resources, and Occupational Health and Safety teams to ensure the accurate interpretation and application of all national labor laws and their financial implications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Payroll Operations: Manage and execute the full payroll lifecycle, including data entry, processing, advances, monthly closing, and managing all related bank transactions.
  • Compliance & Regulatory Reporting (DP Focus): Ensure absolute compliance with all local taxes, statutory obligations, and labor legislation (CLT). This includes managing specific government requirements such as eSocial, eConsignado, and other mandated regulatory reporting.
  • Financial Reconciliation: Lead the complex payroll general ledger account reconciliation process and coordinate the period closing activities with the Accounting and Finance teams.
  • Absence & Leave Management: Oversee and accurately process all employee events related to Personnel Administration (DP), including absences, sick leaves, medical leaves, and temporary contract suspensions and legally mandated leaves, ensuring adherence to company policy and legal requirements.
  • Policy & Audit Support: Review, develop, and update internal payroll and DP policies and procedures. Act as the key contact and support resource for both internal and external audits.
  • System Administration: Configure and maintain the payroll system (e.g., ADP) to reflect new rules, regulations, and benefit changes. Manage all payments to payroll-related third-party vendors.
  • Strategic Reporting: Develop and deliver insightful managerial reports and in-depth analyses of payroll processes to support business decision-making and forecasting.


Basic Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Accounting, or Human Resources Management, with a strong focus or specialization in Personnel Administration (Departamento Pessoal - DP).
  • Experience: Proven, extensive experience in end-to-end payroll processing and administration in a complex environment.
  • Legal Expertise: Deep knowledge and understanding of local Brazilian Labor Legislation (CLT) and associated union/collective bargaining obligations.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in payroll systems (e.g., ADP is highly preferred), Advanced Excel skills, and experience with Google Workspace/Tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Demonstrated ability to perform complex account reconciliation, proactively identify issues, and resolve discrepancies quickly and accurately.
  • Analytical Ability: Strong capacity to gather data, perform complex analysis, and develop clear, actionable managerial reports.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential for effective interaction with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and auditors.
  • Language: Advanced English proficiency is required. Spanish proficiency is desirable.


EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a fast-paced, customer-centric team focused on delivering personalized digital experiences at scale. In this role, you will contribute to the development of full-stack solutions that power marketing and personalization initiatives across web platforms. You will work within a modern MarTech ecosystem, helping to build and maintain customer-facing features, support data-driven experiences, and ensure the reliability of high-traffic user journeys.

  • Strong experience working with modern frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with backend development using Java/Spring Boot.
  • Understanding of API development and system integrations.
  • Foundational knowledge of event-driven systems, message queues, and data pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to adapt in fast-paced environments.
  • Understanding of digital product development and user experience principles.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Familiarity with MarTech concepts, including content management, targeting, and personalization.
  • Experience with CMS platforms such as Contentful.
  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDP) such as Segment.io.
  • Exposure to personalization tools and strategies.
  • Experience working with event pipelines, serverless functions, or data streaming systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS), CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins), and containerization (Kubernetes).
  • Experience in subscription-based or e-commerce platforms.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como principal referência técnica da frente de Observabilidade , sendo o ponto de escalonamento para incidentes críticos e complexos.
  • Gerenciar em tempo real o fluxo de incidentes , acompanhando chamados em andamento e finalizados para evitar formação de backlog.
  • Controlar e otimizar indicadores operacionais como TMR (Tempo Médio de Resposta) e SLA , garantindo rápida reação a incidentes de infraestrutura.
  • Analisar a volumetria de alertas e ofensores, realizando o balanceamento contínuo das frentes de atuação da equipe.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on no troubleshooting avançado de incidentes críticos e paradas sistêmicas.
  • Conduzir a priorização técnica de incidentes e o escalonamento para parceiros tecnológicos em situações de crise.
  • Realizar diagnósticos avançados em conectividade e redes , incluindo links dedicados, banda larga e contingência.
  • Garantir a qualidade operacional dos atendimentos realizados por times terceiros, avaliando registros, resoluções e encerramentos no ServiceNow .
  • Apoiar auditorias técnicas e validações de atendimento, assegurando correto raciocínio técnico e não apenas execução de scripts.
  • Atuar de forma estratégica, identificando causas raiz de problemas recorrentes e propondo melhorias estruturais para a operação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Sólida experiência em NOC / Centro de Operações , com atuação em monitoramento contínuo e gestão de incidentes críticos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de Observabilidade , com forte experiência prática em Zabbix e Grafana .

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

title: Clinical Trial Manager / Senior Clinical Trial Manager
description:
Clinical Trial Manager (CTM)/Sr CTM, Clinical Operations


Nexcella, Inc.


Our 3 Core Values

  • Intelligence
  • Integrity
  • Initiative


What You'll Do

The Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) leads the strategic and operational execution of cell therapy clinical trials, owning the full patient treatment pathway from apheresis through manufacturing, product release, and infusion. Serving as the cross-functional integrator across Clinical Operations, CMC, Manufacturing, Regulatory, Medical, Quality, and Supply Chain. The CTM ensures seamless execution, strict chain of identity and custody, inspection readiness, and on-time delivery of critical study milestones while safeguarding patient safety and product integrity


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the day-to-day operational execution of assigned cell therapy trials: study startup, site activation, enrollment, monitoring, close-out.
  • Develop and manage study timelines, budgets, forecasts, and related operational metrics.
  • Partner with external vendors / CROs / service providers (monitoring, labs, imaging, manufacturing/supply chain for cell product) to ensure high quality and timely deliverables.
  • Serve as the primary cross-functional operational contact for study teams (clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, regulatory, safety/pharmacovigilance, manufacturing, supply chain, medical affairs, quality).
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and quality standards (FDA, EMA, ICH-GCP, relevant local regulations) and internal SOPs.
  • Participate in protocol development and amendments, informed consent form (ICF) review, CRF/data tool development, TMF (Trial Master File) setup & maintenance, monitoring plan, data review plan, drug/cell-product accountability and reconciliation.

  • Foster effective communication across study teams, escalate issues to senior leadership as needed.
  • Ensure preparation for audits/inspections, maintain high standards of documentation readiness.
  • Contribute to lessons-learned and process improvement initiatives, particularly around cell-therapy-specific operational challenges (e.g., chain of identity/chain of custody, logistics of product, unique site training).
  • Review invoices and track study budget according to the forecast, working closely with finance and clinical business operations.
  • Develop study documents and tools including study, informed consent forms, project plans, budgets, study templates, and other materials as needed.
  • Vendor Management – Contribute to or lead cross-program vendor management activities
  • Contribute to SOP development within the Clinical Operations team

Qualifications

  • B.S. degree with minimum 7-10 years of experience in clinical operations including managing clinical trials in biotech, pharmaceutical.

  • Strong leadership, effective decision making, and problem-solving skills required.
  • Established Cell Therapy /CAR T study experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of relevant GCPs and FDA/EMA regulations.

  • Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision and multi-task activities to effectively manage deliverables across all trials.
  • Experience in small/mid biotechnology environment (startup mindset)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills


About Nexcella, Inc.

Nexcella, Inc. is a subsidiary of Immix Biopharma, Inc. (ImmixBio) (Nasdaq: IMMX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201 with a “digital filter” that filters out non-specific activation. NXC-201 is being evaluated in the U.S. multi-center study for relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis NEXICART-2 (NCT ), with a registrational design. Interim results were presented at ASCO 2025 in an oral presentation by Heather Landau, M.D. of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior QA Engineer with 7+ years of QA experience to join the software engineering team of our U.S. client. Primary duties include testing all new feature enhancements, maintaining test cases, and performing application regression testing. This key individual should have confidence in making decisions as well as working both independently and as a part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Supervisor Técnico Predial
description:
Descrição da Vaga


Na RPS - Real Property Solution , temos um compromisso permanente com a excelência, a preservação do patrimônio e a satisfação de nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais experientes e dedicados que contribuem para o desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas e estratégicas no mercado imobiliário.

Atuamos com clientes nacionais e internacionais, oferecendo uma experiência diferenciada em consultoria, gestão e análise técnica de ativos imobiliários.


Descrição da Posição


O Supervisor Técnico Predial exerce um papel fundamental no apoio às atividades de vistoria, diagnóstico técnico e análise das condições físicas de empreendimentos imobiliários.

Este profissional atua diretamente em inspeções multidisciplinares, auxiliando na identificação de patologias construtivas, verificação de conformidades técnicas e análise das condições de sistemas prediais e infraestrutura.

Além da atuação em campo, o profissional também contribui para a organização das informações coletadas, elaboração de relatórios técnicos e apoio à equipe de gestão na interpretação dos dados levantados, contribuindo para a preservação patrimonial e para o planejamento adequado das ações de manutenção e melhoria dos ativos imobiliários.

Espera-se que o profissional tenha forte atenção aos detalhes, organização e capacidade analítica para identificar riscos potenciais, registrar informações técnicas de forma clara e colaborar com soluções que promovam a segurança, eficiência e longevidade dos empreendimentos avaliados.


Principais Responsabilidades


• Apoiar a realização de inspeções prediais e vistorias técnicas em empreendimentos imobiliários e ativos sob gestão.

• Auxiliar na identificação de patologias construtivas, não conformidades técnicas e oportunidades de melhoria.

• Realizar levantamentos fotográficos e registros técnicos para elaboração de relatórios de inspeção.

• Apoiar a análise das condições de conservação e funcionamento dos sistemas prediais e infraestrutura.

• Organizar informações técnicas e colaborar na elaboração de relatórios de diagnóstico patrimonial.

• Contribuir para o acompanhamento de cronogramas de manutenção e ações corretivas identificadas nas inspeções.

• Apoiar a equipe técnica na leitura e interpretação de projetos e documentos técnicos.

• Colaborar com a equipe na proposição de soluções técnicas e recomendações de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)


Inspeção e Diagnóstico Patrimonial

Capacidade de apoiar inspeções multidisciplinares em diferentes sistemas e componentes da edificação, incluindo:


Civil

  • Identificação de fissuras, recalques, patologias construtivas e condições de acabamentos.
  • Avaliação preliminar da integridade estrutural e condições gerais das edificações.

Elétrica

  • Verificação de quadros de energia, fiação, aterramento e sistemas de iluminação.


Hidráulica

  • Identificação de vazamentos, análise de pressão de rede, barriletes e sistemas de esgoto.


Coberturas

  • Avaliação de telhas, calhas, rufos e sistemas de impermeabilização.


Infraestrutura

  • Verificação de pavimentação (asfalto ou paver), drenagem e estabilidade de taludes.


Sistemas de Incêndio

  • Verificação básica de hidrantes, sprinklers, sinalização de emergência e validade de extintores, conforme normas técnicas aplicáveis.


Softwares e Documentação


• AutoCAD : Leitura e apoio na elaboração de plantas, cortes e detalhes técnicos.

• Pacote Office

  • PowerPoint : Elaboração de relatórios técnicos e apresentações visuais com registros fotográficos.
  • Excel : Controle de cronogramas de manutenção, acompanhamento de inspeções e planilhas de custos.

• Redação Técnica

Capacidade de registrar irregularidades, observações técnicas e recomendações de forma clara, objetiva e estruturada.

• Disponibilidade para viagens , considerando a realização de inspeções e vistorias em diferentes localidades.


Competências Operacionais e Normativas


• Conhecimento básico de normas técnicas da ABNT , especialmente relacionadas à ABNT NBR 16747 .

• Noções de normas de segurança do trabalho aplicáveis às inspeções, incluindo NR-10  e NR-35 .

• Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de projetos “As Built”  para localização de sistemas e redes críticas durante vistorias.

• Apoio no planejamento de manutenção predial, distinguindo entre manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


Atenção aos Detalhes

Capacidade de identificar sinais de patologias ou riscos que possam gerar impactos futuros relevantes.

Comunicação Assertiva

Facilidade para transmitir informações técnicas de forma clara entre a equipe de campo e a gestão.

Proatividade e Resolução de Problemas

Capacidade de identificar riscos ou irregularidades e contribuir com propostas de solução.

Organização

Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos ativos, informações técnicas e prazos de entrega de relatórios.


Formação:

• Ensino Técnico em Edificações .


Formação complementar como diferencial:

• Cursos ou treinamentos em Inspeção Predial, Patologia das Construções, Manutenção Predial ou Gestão de Ativos Imobiliários .


Como se Candidatar


A candidatura poderá ser realizada através do LinkedIn , pelo e-mail   ou através do link:

title: Analista de Tributos Indiretos Júnior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar análise e apuração, entrega de obrigações acessórias, geração e contabilização de pagamentos pertinentes aos tributos indiretos para garantir o compliance tributário e cumprir os prazos exigidos pela legislação fiscal, de forma que evite questionamentos ou autuações que possam gerar desencaixes financeiro para a Companhia;
  • Responsável pelo registro, conferência de notas fiscais de entrada e serviços da matriz no ato do recebimento e conferência dos livros fiscais de entrada e saída de mercadorias, de forma que verifique divergências de fornecedores, valores, CFOP, IVA, retenções de impostos, para garantir o compliance tributário, cumprir os prazos exigidos pela legislação fiscal e evitar questionamentos ou autuações fiscais;
  • Elaboração de controles e pedidos de ressarcimento de ICMS e ICMS-ST de operações interestaduais, pedidos de restituição de imposto, pedidos administrativos de crédito acumulado e ressarcimento de ICMS-ST referentes a diferença de preço (decisão STF), solicitação de restituição financeira referente aos ressarcimentos interestaduais junto à Petrobras afim de recuperar os valores financeiros junto ao fisco;
  • Elaboração e conferência das conciliações fiscal e contábil de forma que garanta o fidedigno registro das operações praticadas pela Companhia e evite questionamentos fiscais.
  • Elaboração e preenchimento dos controles de saldos dos tributos indiretos a recolher e a recuperar no intuito de assegurar a correta compensação e pagamento dos tributos diretos;
  • Análise e revisão dos livros fiscais de entradas e saídas e das obrigações acessórias pertinentes ao ICMS e ICMS-ST (EFD-Fiscal, GIA e afins), para assegurar a correta apuração dos tributos indiretos, prazo de entrega das obrigações, garantir o compliance tributário e evitar questionamentos fiscais;
  • Suporte na criação de ordens de venda, faturas de operações de transferência, brindes e demais remessas, além de identificar oportunidades de automatização dos processos e eliminação de tarefas manuais para garantir o compliance tributário;
  • Acompanhar o monitor de NFe para garantir que todas as notas fiscais emitidas pelos fornecedores ou pela própria Empresa estejam com as etapas concluídas e sejam registradas corretamente, de forma que garanta o correto registro contábil, fiscal, de estoques e financeiro das operações;
  • Acompanhar os prestadores de serviço quanto retificações, pleitos fiscais, venda de créditos, identificação de oportunidades e revisões fiscais, de forma que seja cumprido os prazos definidos em contrato e que garanta o compliance tributário da Companhia;
  • Atendimento à auditoria interna, externa e fiscalizações nos prazos estabelecidos, para que evite questionamentos internos ou autuações fiscais;
  • Estudo e atualização da legislação tributária para desenvolvimento pessoal e dos colaboradores júnior e assistente;
  • Suporte ao analista júnior e assistente, áreas de negócio e atendimento às filiais para que sejam cumpridas as demandas do negócio e garantir a correta aplicação da legislação tributária;
  • Suporte e apoio ao analista sênior, especialista e a coordenação no planejamento tributário, no intuito de garantir o compliance e identificar alternativas de apropriação de créditos ou compensações fiscais e identificação de riscos e oportunidades, para evitar desencaixes financeiros;
  • Controle e organização das demandas de forma a equalizar as atividades nos prazos devidos e atender com excelência das áreas de negócio, bem como manter a conformidade em todas as tarefas sob sua responsabilidade. Ser referência para os demais analistas e possuir boa didática para disseminar conhecimento técnico para toda a equipe;

  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências em GRC, segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, buscando constantemente aprimorar os processos e controles.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas da empresa (ex: Jurídico, Compliance, TI) para garantir a integração das atividades de GRC.
  • Acompanhar e interpretar as mudanças nas legislações e regulamentações relacionadas à segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, adaptando os processos internos conforme necessário.
  • Elaborar relatórios de GRC para a alta gestão, apresentando o status da conformidade, os riscos identificados e as ações implementadas.


Qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência em GRC, com foco em segurança da informação e privacidade de dados.
  • Profundo conhecimento das normas ISO 27001 e ISO 27701.
  • Experiência comprovada em condução de auditorias internas e externas.
  • Habilidade em elaborar políticas, processos, procedimentos e controles de segurança da informação e privacidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de segurança da informação (ex: NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls).
  • Conhecimento em regulamentações de privacidade de dados (ex: LGPD, GDPR).

title: Web & Mobile App UI/UX Designer
description:
About Chop Dawg


Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Chop Dawg builds custom mobile apps, web platforms, and AI products for partners worldwide. We've launched over 500 apps with a 92% partner retention rate, working with everyone from first-time founders to Fortune 500 companies, including NASA, The White House, Jefferson Health, Six Flags, Wawa, Hilton, the NFL, and the U.S. Navy. Our teams span across the United States, Brazil, and Pakistan.


We don't call our clients \"clients.\" We call them partners, because that's the relationship we build. We're not a vendor you hire and check in with at the end. We're in it with you from day one, and this role is at the heart of how our partners experience the products we create together.


The Role


You GOTTA love designing apps. Not just making screens look beautiful, but thinking deeply about how users interact with digital products, how they move through an experience, and how great design decisions lead to great outcomes.


As a Web & Mobile App UI/UX Designer at Chop Dawg, you'll be joining our growing Brazilian design team of 9 designers, working alongside 2 American designers, as part of an 11-person creative powerhouse. You'll work directly with our partners across the United States and beyond, translating their ideas into thoughtful, polished, and development-ready designs.


This is a full-time, 40-hour per week commitment. Our designers typically manage 2 to 3 active partner projects at any given time, so you need to be someone who thrives juggling multiple workstreams, staying organized, and delivering quality work across all of them without missing a beat.


Every project is different. Our partners span industries and stages, from first-time founders with a napkin sketch to established companies looking to build their next big product. What stays consistent is the standard: every product we design should be something our partners are proud to launch and their users love to use.


What You'll Do


  • Design mobile apps, web applications, marketing websites, and branding assets for partners across a wide range of industries
  • Manage your workload across 2 to 3 concurrent projects, keeping each one moving forward on schedule and at a high standard
  • Create user personas, site maps, wireframes, low-fidelity and high-fidelity designs, product flows, and documentation
  • Build and maintain component libraries that keep design systems consistent across projects
  • Develop non-functional prototypes to validate design direction before development begins
  • Design branding elements including app icons, logo designs, and Apple App Store and Google Play Store assets
  • Collaborate directly with partners via Zoom to present work, gather feedback, and refine direction
  • Work closely with project managers, developers, and fellow designers through Slack, Jira, and Confluence to keep projects moving
  • Participate in design reviews and iterate based on partner and team feedback
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude and Google Stitch to enhance your workflow and output quality


What We're Looking For


Required


  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken. This is non-negotiable. You will be communicating directly with American partners daily, and clear, professional English is essential.
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connection
  • Available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating experience designing mobile apps, web applications, and branding
  • Proficiency with Figma as your primary design tool
  • Experience with user personas, site mapping, wireframing, high-fidelity design, product flows, non-functional prototyping, and component libraries
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Experience working directly with partners and teams based in the United States
  • Experience working in an agency setting, ideally serving American or European clientele
  • Proficiency with Slack and Zoom for daily communication and partner meetings
  • Available to start immediately or within the next few weeks


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing for wearable devices and tablets
  • Familiarity with Jira and Confluence
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered design and productivity tools such as Claude and Google Stitch
  • Previous project management experience
  • Background in branding including app icons, logo design, and app store asset creation


Compensation


Starting at $1,000 USD/month, scaling up to $4,500 USD/month as you grow into the role and take on expanded responsibilities.


Availability


Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST. This is a full-time, 40-hour per week position. Must be based in Brazil.


Reports To:  Design leadership and CEO/CTO


Why Chop Dawg


We don't chase volume. We invest in relationships. That's how we've maintained a 92% partner retention rate and built a portfolio that spans startups, government agencies, and some of the most recognized brands in the world. Our Brazilian design team is growing because the talent is exceptional, and we want you to be part of that growth story. You won't be designing in a silo. You'll be collaborating with a tight-knit, international team that genuinely cares about the work and the people we do it for.


If you take pride in your craft, love working on products that matter to real people, and want to be part of a team that treats design as the foundation of everything we build, we'd love to see your work.


How to Apply


Apply directly through this posting. Include a link to your portfolio. Tell us about your design experience, the types of products you've worked on, and what drew you to this role.


Chop Dawg is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.

You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.

You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.

Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
  • Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
  • Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / DevOps role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly.

You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly , and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments.

  • Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments.
  • Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts.
  • Hands‑on production experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage.
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations , including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices.
  • Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends.
  • Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines.
  • Solid reliability engineering experience , including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety.
  • Scripting ability using Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate infrastructure development, incident response, and documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with VP-level stakeholders during architectural reviews and operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and own Azure cloud architecture for a greenfield PEG platform , including subscription structure, networking, identity, and environment separation.
  • Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services , ensuring high availability and operational resilience.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation.
  • Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments.
  • Design and maintain monitoring and alerting strategies across platform services, ensuring visibility into availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues, coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Improve platform reliability, automation, and developer experience through proactive runbook creation and operational documentation.
  • Partner with security and engineering stakeholders on network policies, access controls, private connectivity, and compliance requirements.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments.
  • Expertise operating Kubernetes/AKS workloads and Azure PaaS services in production contexts.
  • IaC background with Terraform , including environment separation and state management at scale.
  • Use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.
